physicalNotes: Radius 0.18734977 Jupiter radii from Bonomo et al. 2023 (2023A&A...677A..33B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract): 13,394 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Bonomo et al. 2023 (2023A&A...677A..33B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..33B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.0286318 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
